title: What to do in San Diego on a rainy day: museums, the Midway and indoor food halls
excerpt: San Diego's rain falls mostly from November to March. These indoor stops, from Balboa Park museums to the USS Midway and Liberty Public Market, keep a wet day on track.

seo.title: Rainy Day in San Diego: Indoor Things to Do
seo.description: Rainy day in San Diego? Balboa Park museums, the USS Midway, Birch Aquarium and Liberty Public Market, with hours, prices and when to swim again.

heroCaption: A living room with a fireplace in one of the San Diego homes Cardo manages.
bodyHtml:
San Diego gets only a handful of wet days a year, but they cluster in winter, which is also when many visitors come. A rainy morning does not have to cost you the day. Here are the indoor stops that work best, what they cost and when they open, and one rule for the beach after the rain stops.

As of November 2026

Hours and prices come from each venue's own website and can change for holidays and events. Check the day before you go.

When does it rain in San Diego?

Mostly between November and March. The National Weather Service puts the city's seasonal rainfall at about 10 inches and says 85% of it falls in those five months. Storms tend to arrive as a day or two of showers followed by clear, cool weather, so a flexible plan usually means moving the beach day rather than losing it.

Where should you go in Balboa Park when it rains?

Balboa Park puts several museums within a short walk of each other along El Prado, so you can park once and move between them under the arcades. Three that suit a wet day:

  • Fleet Science Center: hands-on exhibits, Kid City for young children and a film in the giant dome theater. Open daily 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; adults $29.95, ages 3 to 12 $24.95. It closes from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. on December 4 and 5 for December Nights.
  • San Diego Natural History Museum (The Nat): five floors of exhibits and a giant screen theater. Open daily 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; adults $24.95, ages 3 to 17 $16.95. On Fridays it stays open until 11 p.m., at half price after 5 p.m.
  • Timken Museum of Art: a small painting collection with free admission and no tickets required. Open Wednesday through Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Fans of science fiction can add the Comic-Con Museum, where the Doctor Who exhibition runs through January 14, 2027 (Comic-Con Museum). Our family guide to Balboa Park and La Jolla covers more of the park's museums.

Is the USS Midway worth it on a rainy day?

Yes, and it may be the best single choice for a full wet day. Most of the tour runs through the ship's interior: the hangar deck and the compartments below it. The museum recommends four to five hours on board and allows same-day re-entry. The flight deck is open to the weather, so save it for a break in the showers.

According to the USS Midway Museum, it is open daily 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., with last admission at 4 p.m. Adult tickets are $39 online and $41 at the door; ages 4 to 12 are $29 online. Children 3 and under and active-duty military get in free. Expect ladders and steep stairs, and wear closed-toe shoes.

Which indoor spots work for young kids?

The New Children's Museum downtown is built around hands-on art and play. It is open six days a week, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.; check its calendar for the closed day. Tickets are $25 for adults and $20 for children 1 and older.

In La Jolla, Birch Aquarium at Scripps opens daily at 9 a.m., with closing times that vary by season. Adult tickets are $34.95 online and $39.95 at the door; ages 3 to 12 are $29.95 online. Children 2 and under are free. Most of the exhibits are indoors.

Where can you eat and wait out the rain?

Liberty Public Market in Point Loma puts food stalls, a bar and shops under one roof at Liberty Station. The market is open daily 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., though individual vendors set their own hours. It is an easy place to feed a group that cannot agree on lunch. For more ideas, see our guide to eating your way down the coast.

What is closed over Thanksgiving and Christmas?

The USS Midway, Fleet Science Center and Liberty Public Market close on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Birch Aquarium closes on both and on New Year's Day. If you are in town for the holidays, our December events guide covers what is on in December.

When is it safe to swim again after rain?

Wait three days. After 0.2 inches or more of rain, the County of San Diego Department of Environmental Health issues a general advisory and asks beachgoers to avoid contact with ocean and bay water for 72 hours after the rain ends, because runoff raises bacteria levels, especially near storm drains, rivers and lagoon mouths. Walking the sand is fine. When the advisory lifts, our guide to the best beach for your trip can help you pick one.

Where should you stay for a winter trip?

A home with a full kitchen, a comfortable living room and space to spread out makes a rainy afternoon easier, especially with children. Cardo's homes in La Jolla, Pacific Beach and nearby neighborhoods are bookable directly at booking.cardorentals.com.
